video_title: Tyrese Haliburton Broke Down During Postgame Interview with Jeremiah Johnson 🥹

quotes.speaker: Tyrese Haliburton
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyrese Haliburton on his emotional return to the court
quotes.excerpt: It means a lot to be back out here.

text_blocks.speaker: Jeremiah Johnson
text_blocks.text: Tyrese, one point during the fourth quarter, Christian is rallying off your stats and Quinn Buckner says it's not the stats, it's the spirit. You walked on the floor before this game started with a big smile on your face. I just saw it as you were embracing your teammates. How much fun were you having tonight?

text_blocks.speaker: Tyrese Haliburton
text_blocks.text: It means a lot to be back out here. I'm just really thankful to be back out here.

quotes.social_post: Tyrese Haliburton reflects on his return to the court after being sidelined. It means a lot to be back out here. I am just really thankful to be back out here.

structured.context: Tyrese Haliburton expresses his gratitude for returning to the court following an injury during a postgame interview with Jeremiah Johnson.

quotes.speaker: Tyrese Haliburton
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyrese Haliburton on the Pacers' team chemistry and development
quotes.excerpt: We're battle tested so we finished this game the right way. Really proud of this group.

text_blocks.speaker: Jeremiah Johnson
text_blocks.text: I could ask you about a lot of different plays in the game, but what we saw was a rebound from Zubac, an outlet to you, and Pascal Siakam a finish. How is that Pacers basketball?

text_blocks.speaker: Tyrese Haliburton
text_blocks.text: It's coming along well. We got a lot to pick up. Second quarter wasn't good, but we're battle tested so we finished this game the right way. Really proud of this group.

quotes.social_post: Tyrese Haliburton on the Pacers progress. The team is coming along well and he is proud of the group for finishing the game the right way despite a rough second quarter.

structured.context: Tyrese Haliburton discusses the team's performance and chemistry after a specific play involving Pascal Siakam during a postgame interview.
